criteria.name: Evolving cartel fragmentation
criteria.description: Assess internal splits within major criminal organizations and how factional rivalries reshape power balances and fuel localized surges in violence.

criteria.name: Territorial diffusion of conflict
criteria.description: Track how violence spreads beyond traditional hotspots into new regions as organizations exploit openings and contest emerging markets.

criteria.name: Shift to diversified revenue
criteria.description: Examine gangs’ growing reliance on extortion, human smuggling, and fuel theft and how competition over these markets drives conflict dynamics.

criteria.name: Arms and tactics escalation
criteria.description: Monitor increased use of explosives, drones, and remote attacks that enable asymmetric warfare and intimidation of civilians.

criteria.name: CJNG expansion opportunities
criteria.description: Evaluate how one major group leverages rivals’ fragmentation to push into contested areas and forge opportunistic alliances, intensifying clashes.

criteria.name: Sinaloa network instability
criteria.description: Analyze how internal rifts in a dominant network disrupt regional criminal ecosystems and trigger spillover violence in adjacent states.

criteria.name: State security posture shift
criteria.description: Assess indications of a move from restraint to more assertive operations and how this affects confrontation rates and public security.

criteria.name: Militarization and human rights risks
criteria.description: Evaluate the expanding role of military and quasi-military forces in public security and associated risks of abuses and civilian harm.

criteria.name: Political violence and co-optation
criteria.description: Track intimidation, attacks, and co-optation of political actors as gangs seek influence over local governance and public institutions.

criteria.name: Judicial vulnerability and impunity
criteria.description: Assess how reforms and institutional weaknesses may increase criminal penetration of the judiciary, undermining accountability and trust.

criteria.name: US policy pressure impacts
criteria.description: Analyze how a harder external stance on drugs and migration shapes Mexico’s security strategy, enforcement priorities, and gang behavior.

criteria.name: Migration-crime nexus
criteria.description: Monitor how tighter migration controls increase the profitability of human smuggling, funding gang expansion and intensifying route conflicts.

criteria.name: Civic harm and displacement
criteria.description: Evaluate trends in civilian targeting, displacement, and community coercion as groups assert control and state responses intensify.

criteria.name: Market spillovers across regions
criteria.description: Assess how conflicts over strategic markets (e.g., fuel theft, border control) in one state trigger knock-on violence in neighboring areas.

criteria.name: Prospects for short-term escalation
criteria.description: Gauge likelihood of near-term upticks in clashes and lethality due to factional competition, opportunistic expansions, and assertive policing.
